original: yan... nv... aham imāny ābharaṇāni puṣkiriṇyām prakṣipeyam iti.
analyzed: yat nu aham imāni ābharaṇāni puṣkiriṇyām prakṣipeyam iti

original: tato mahāprajāpatī gautamī tāny ābharaṇāni puṣkiriṇyām prakṣipati sma.

original: adyāpi sā evaṃ saṃjñāyate.
analyzed: adya api sā evam saṃjñāyate

original: tatredam ucyate.
analyzed: tatra idam ucyate

original: niṣkrāntu sūro yada vidu... bodhisattvo... nagaraṃ vibuddhaṃ kapilapuraṃ samagraṃ manyanti sarve śayanagato kumāro anyonya tuṣṭāḥ pramudita ālapante.

original: gopā vibuddhā api istrigāro śayanaṃ nirīkṣī na dṛśi bodhisattvaṃ utkrośu mukto narapatino agāre hā vañcitā smaḥ kahi gatu bodhisattvo.

original: gopā śayāto dharaṇitale nipatya keśāṃ lunātī avaśiri bhūṣaṇāni aho subhāṣṭaṃ mama nāyakenā sarvapriyebhir naciratu viprayogaḥ.

original: rūpāsurūpā vimala vicitritāṅgā acchā viśuddhā jagati priyā manāpā dhanyā prasastā divi bhuvi pūjanīyā kva tvam gato 'sī mama śayi chorayitvā.
analyzed: rūpāsurūpā vimala vicitritāṅgā acchā viśuddhā jagati priyā manāpā dhanyā prasastā divi bhuvi pūjanīyā kva tvam gato sī mama śayi chorayitvā

original: na pāsyi pānaṃ na ca madhunā pramādyaṃ bhūmau śayiṣye jaṭamakuṭaṃ dhariṣye snānaṃ jahitvā vratatapa yāvan na drakṣye guṇadharu bodhisattvam.
analyzed: na pāsyi pānam na ca madhunā pramādyam bhūmau śayiṣye jaṭa makuṭam dhariṣye snānam jahitvā vratatapa yāvat na drakṣye guṇadharu bodhisattvam

original: udyāna sarve aphala hārā viśuddhā tamarajapāṃśutulyāḥ vesmaṃ na śobhī aṭavi puram prakāsaṃ yat tena tyaktaṃ naravarapuṃgavena.
analyzed: udyāna sarve aphala hārā viśuddhā tamaraja pāṃśu tulyāḥ na śobhī aṭavi puram prakāsam yat tena tyaktam nara vara puṃgavena

original: hā gītavādyāḥ sumadhuramañjughoṣāḥ hā istrigārā vigaḍita bhūṣaṇāni hā hemajālaiḥ parisphuṭam antarikṣaṃ na bhūyu drakṣye guṇadharaviprahīṇā.
analyzed: hā gīta vādyāḥ sumadhura mañju ghoṣāḥ hā bhūṣaṇāni hā hema jālaiḥ parisphuṭam antarikṣam na drakṣye guṇadhara viprahīṇā

original: mātṛsvasā cā paramasukṛcchraprāptā āśvāsayatī ma rudahi śākyakanye pūrve... ca... uktaṃ naravarapuṃgavena kartāsmi loke jaramaraṇāt pramokṣaṃ.

original: so cā mahārṣī kuśalasahasracīrṇaḥ ṣaḍyojanānī pratigatu rātrīśeṣe chandasya detī hayavaru bhūṣaṇāni chandā gṛhītvā kapilapuraṃ prayāhī.

original: mātāpitṝṇāṃ mama vacanena pṛcche gataḥ kumāro ma ca puna śocayethā buddhitva bodhiṃ punar ihamāgamiṣye dharmaṃ śruṇitvā bhaviṣyatha sāntacittāḥ.
analyzed: mātā pitṝṇām mama vacanena pṛcche gataḥ kumāraḥ mā ca punar śocayethāḥ bodhim punar iham āgamiṣye dharmam śruṇitvā bhaviṣyatha sa anta cittāḥ

original: chando rudanto pratibhaṇi nāyakasya na me 'sti śaktir balata parākramo vā haneyu mahyaṃ naravarajnātisamghāḥ chandā kva nīto guṇadhara bodhisattvo.
analyzed: nāyakasya na me sti śaktiḥ balataḥ parākramaḥ vā haneyu mahyam nara vara jnāti samghāḥ kva nītaḥ guṇadhara bodhisattvaḥ

original: mā bhāhi chandā pratibhaṇi bodhisattvaḥ tuṣṭā bhavitvā mama jñātisaṃghāḥ śāstārasaṃjñā tvayi sada bhāviṣyanti premeṇa mahyaṃ tvayam vartiṣyante.
analyzed: mā bhāhi bodhisattvaḥ tuṣṭāḥ bhavitvā mama jñāti saṃghāḥ tvayi bhāviṣyanti premeṇa mahyam vartiṣyante

original: chando gṛhītvā hayavaru bhūṣaṇāni udyāna prāpto naravarapuṃgavasya udyānapālaḥ pramuditu vegajāto ānandaśabdaṃ pratibhaṇi śākiyānām.
analyzed: chandaḥ gṛhītvā bhūṣaṇāni udyāna prāptaḥ nara vara puṃgavasya udyāna pālaḥ ānanda śabdam śākiyānām

original: ayaṃ kumārohayavaru chandakaś ca udyāna prāpto na ca punaḥ śocitavyo rājā śruṇitvā parivṛtu śākiyebhiḥ udyāna prāpto pramuditu vegajāto.
analyzed: ayam chandakaḥ ca udyāna prāptaḥ na ca punar śocitavyaḥ rājā śruṇitvā śākiyebhiḥ udyāna prāpto vegajāto

original: gopā viditvā dṛḍhamati bodhisattvaṃ no cāpi harṣī na ca giraaddadhāti asthānam etad vinigatu yat kumāro aprāpya bodhiṃ punar iha dṛṣṭvā tu rājā hayavaru chandakaṃ ca utkrosu kṛtvā dharaṇītale nirasto hā mahya putrā sukuśalagītavādyā kva tvaṃ gato 'sī vijahiya sarvarājyaṃ.
analyzed: gopāḥ viditvā bodhisattvam no ca api harṣī na ca asthānam etat yat kumāraḥ a prāpya bodhim punar iha dṛṣṭvā tu rājā chandakam ca kṛtvā dharaṇī tale nirastaḥ hā kva tvam su kuśala gīta vādyā kva tvam sarva rājyam

original: sādhū bhaṇāhī vacana mameha chandā kiṃ vā prayogaḥ kva ca gatu bodhisattvaḥ kenātha nīto vivarita kena dvārā pūjā ca tasyāḥ katha kṛta devasaṃghaiḥ.

original: chando bhaṇātī śṛṇu mama pārthivendrā rātrau prasupte nagari so mañjughoṣo mama bhaṇi bodhisattvo chandā dadāhī mama laghu aśvarājaṃ.

original: so bodhayāmī naragaṇī nārīsaṃghaṃ suptāḥ prasuptāḥ na ca gira te śruṇanti so rodamāno dadi ahu aśvarājaṃ hanta vrajāhī hitakara yena kāmaṃ.
analyzed: saḥ bodhayāmī nara gaṇī nārī saṃgham suptāḥ prasuptāḥ na ca giraḥ te śruṇanti saḥ rodamānaḥ aśva rājam hanta vraja ahi hita kara yena kāmam

original: śakreṇa dvārā vivarita yantrayuktāḥ pālāś catasro hayacaraṇeṣu śliṣṭāḥ ārūḍhi sūre pracalita trisahasrāḥ mārgo nabhesmin suvipulu yena krānto.
analyzed: śakreṇa yantra yuktāḥ pālāḥ catasraḥ haya caraṇeṣu śliṣṭāḥ ārūḍhi sūre mārgaḥ nabhesmin yena

original: ābhā pramuktā vihata tamo'ndhakāraḥ puṣpā patiṃsū turiyaśatā raṇiṃsū devā stavimṣū tatha 'pi hi cāpsarāṇī nabhasā prayāto parivṛtu devasaṃghaiḥ.
analyzed: ābhā pramuktā vihata tamaḥ ndhakāraḥ devāḥ devāḥ hi hi ca apsarāṇī nabhasā prayātaḥ deva saṃghaiḥ

original: chando gṛhītvā hayavaru bhūṣaṇāni antaḥpure so rodamāno dṛṣṭvā tu gopā hayavaru chandakaṃ ca sammūrchayitvā dharaṇitale nirastā.
analyzed: chandaḥ gṛhītvā bhūṣaṇāni antaḥpure saḥ rodamānaḥ dṛṣṭvā tu gopā chandakam ca sammūrchayitvā dharaṇi tale nirastā

original: udyukta sarvo suvipulanārisaṃgho vāriṃ gṛhītvā snapayiṣu śākyakanyām mā hāīva kālaṃ kariṣyati śokaprāptāḥ dvābhyāṃ priyābhyāṃ bahu bhavi viprayogo.

original: sthāmaṃ janitvā suduḥkhita śākyakanyā kaṇṭhe '...valambyā hayavaraaśvarājo... anusmaritvā purimaka kāmakrīḍāṃ nānāpralāpāṃ pralapati śokaprāptā.

original: hā mahya prītijananā hā mama narapuṃgavā vimalacandramukhā hā mama surūparūpā hā mama varalakṣaṇā vimalatejadharā.

original: hā mama anantakīrte śatapuṇyasamudgatā vimalapuṇyadharā hā mama anantavarṇā guṇagaṇapratimaṇḍitā ṛṣiṇa prītikarā.

original: hā mama sujātajātā lumbinīvanauttame bhramaragītarute hā mama vighuṣṭaśabdā divi bhuvi abhipūjitā vipulajñānadrumā.

original: hā mama gajahastorū karacaraṇaviśuddhasobhanā tāmranakhā imi tasya bhūṣaṇānī puṇyehi kṛtāni pārthive prītikarā.

original: hā mahya gītavādyā varapuṣpavilepanā śubharitupravare hā mahya puṣpagandhā antaḥpuri gītavāditair harṣakarā.

original: hā kaṇṭhakā sujātā mama bhartu sahāyakas tvayā kva nīto hā chandakā nikaruṇā na bodhayasi gacchamānake naravariṣṭhe.
analyzed: hā kaṇṭhakā sujātā mama bhartu sahāyakaḥ tvayā kva nītaḥ hā chandakā nikaruṇā na bodhayasi gacchamānake nara variṣṭhe

original: gacchati ayam hitakaro ekā gira tasminn antari bhaṇi kasmāt itu adya puravarāto gacchati naradamyasārathiḥ kāruṇikaḥ.

original: katha vā gato hitakaro kena ca niṣkrāmito itu sa katamāṃ diśām anugato dhanyā vanagulmadevatā yāsya sakhī.

original: atiduḥkha mahya chandā nidhi darśaya netra uddhṛtā cakṣu dadā sarvair jinaiś ca chandā mātāpitṛ nitya varṇitā pūjanīyāḥ.

original: tān api jahitva nirgatu kiṃ aṅga punaḥ imakāmaratiṃ... hā dhik priyair viyogo naṭaraṅgasvabhāvavāsaṃnibho anityo.

original: saṃjñāgraheṇa bālā dṛṣṭiviparyāsa niśritā janmacyutau prāg eva tena bhaṇitaṃ nāsti jarāmaraṇasaṃskṛte kaści sakhā.

original: paripūryato 'ṣya āsā spṛśatū varabodhim uttamāṃ drumavariṣṭhe buddhitva bodhivirajāṃ punar... api... etū ihā puravare... asmin... chandakaḥ paramadīnamānaso gopikāya vacanaṃ śruṇitvanā sāśrukaṇṭha gira samprabhāṣate sādhu gopi niśṛṇohi me vacaḥ.

original: rātriye rahasi yāmi madhyame sarvanārigaṇa samprasuptake so tadā ca śatapuṇyaudgato ālapātī mama dehi kaṇṭhakam.

original: taṃ niśāmya vacanaṃ tadantaraṃ tubhya prekṣami śayānī suptikām uccaghoṣu ahu tatra muñcamī utthi gopi ayu yāti te priyo.
analyzed: tam niśāmya vacanam tad antaram śayānī suptikām tatra te

original: devatā vacanu taṃ nirodhayī eka istri na ca budhyate rodamāna samalaṃkaritvanā aśvarāju dadamī narottame.

original: kaṇṭhako hisati ugratejavān krośamātru svaru tasya gacchatī no ca kaści śṛṇute purottame devatābhiḥ osvāpanam kṛtam.
analyzed: ugra tejavān ugra tejavān tasya gacchati no ca kaści śṛṇute pura uttame devatābhiḥ osvāpanam kṛtam

original: svarṇarūpyamaṇikoṭitā mahī kaṇṭhakasya caraṇaiḥ parāhatā sā raṇī madhuru bhīṣmasobhanam no ca keci śṛṇuvanti mānuṣāḥ.
analyzed: svarṇa rūpya maṇi koṭitā mahī kaṇṭhakasya caraṇaiḥ parāhatā sā raṇī bhīṣma sobhanam no ca śṛṇuvanti mānuṣāḥ

original: puṣya yuktu abhu tasmi antare candrajyotiṣa nabhe pratiṣṭhitāḥ devakoṭi gagaṇe kṛtāñjalī onamanti sirasābhivandiṣuḥ.
analyzed: tasmi antare candrajyotiṣa nabhe pratiṣṭhitāḥ devakoṭi gagaṇe kṛtāñjalī onamanti sirasā abhivandiṣuḥ

original: yakṣarākṣasagaṇā upasthitā lokapāla caturo mahārddhikāḥ kaṇṭhakasya caraṇām kare nyasī padmakeśaraviśuddhanirmale.
analyzed: yakṣa rākṣasa gaṇāḥ upasthitāḥ lokapāla caturaḥ mahārddhikāḥ kaṇṭhakasya kare padma keśara viśuddha nirmale

original: so ca puṇyaśatatejaudgato āruhī kumudavarṣikopamam ṣaḍvikāra dharaṇī prakampitā buddhakṣetra sphuṭa nirmalāḥ.

original: śakra devataguruḥ śacīpatiḥ svāma dvāra vivarī tadantare devakoṭinayutaiḥ puraskṛto so vrajī amaranāgapūjitaḥ.

original: saṃjñamātra iha jāni kaṇṭhako lokanātha vahamī nabho'ntare devadānavagaṇāḥ saindrikāḥ ye vahanti sugatasya gacchataḥ.
analyzed: saṃjña mātraḥ iha nabhontare deva dānava gaṇāḥ saindrikāḥ ye vahanti sugatasya gacchataḥ

original: apsarā kuśala gītavādite bodhisattvaguṇa bhāṣamānikāḥ kaṇṭhakasya balu te dadantikāḥ muñci ghoṣu madhuraṃ manoramam.
analyzed: gīta vādite bodhisattva guṇa bhāṣamānikāḥ kaṇṭhakasya te dadantikāḥ madhuram manoramam

original: kaṇṭhakā vahahi lokanāyakaṃ śīghraśīghra ma janehi khedatām nāsti te bhayam apāya durgatī lokanātham abhirādhayitvanā.
analyzed: vahahi lokanāyakam śīghra śīghra janehi kheda tām na asti te bhayam durgatī lokanātham

original: ekameka abhinandate suro vāhanam siya lokanāyake no ca kiṃcid api deśu vidyate devakoṭicaraṇair na marditam.
analyzed: ekam ekaḥ abhinandate suraḥ vāhanam loka nāyake no ca kiṃcid api vidyate deva koṭi caraṇaiḥ na marditam

original: paśya kaṇṭhaka nabho'ntare imām mārgu saṃsthitu vicitraśobhanam ratnavedikavicitramaṇḍitaṃ divyasāravaragandhadhūpitam.
